verdict.rationale: Publishing processing times is a fair question for a government revenue agency, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows the CRA publishing current processing times for business registration or any other transaction type. The closest item, tracking the progress of submitted files (cra-docs-8), is per-file status tracking, an adjacent feature rather than published service-level processing times.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
